# smart-trust-translations

The gettext side of smart-trust's own strings, one directory per target locale: the `glossary/` templates of the GDHCN glossary (`glossary/gdhcn.glossary.json`). A scheme's translations sit with the instance whose terms they translate. Written by `bun run cat glossary:pot`.

Part of [WHO SMART Trust](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `smart-trust-translations`, holding `translation-sources`.
